items.title: Joe Williams interviewed by Leslie Gourse, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: Because I was singing with orchestras for dancing. >> [INTERVIEWER] Johnny Long? [INTERVIEWEE] Yup.

ctx.x: No that happened quite by accident. People started offering me money to sing and they kept offering me more money and more money, and it paid the rent and I was able to save some. Stuff like that. That just happened. Because I was singing with orchestras for dancing.
